content: WXT lets manifest.content_security_policy be set directly in wxt.config.ts's manifest option (per-manifest-version), e.g. manifest: { content_security_policy: { extension_pages: "script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self';" } }. Chrome enforces this minimum CSP for extension_pages when WASM is used. browser_specific_settings.gecko.id/strict_min_version is the Firefox-only manifest block, also settable via the manifest option.
